global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender slices of pork. Topped with shredded menma, sliced green onions, and a sprinkle of red chili flakes, it sits in a white bowl with a red rim, set against a dark, softly lit background.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and slight sheen, appearing smooth and reflective.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with glossy finish, red inner rim, smooth curved surface, subtle glaze reflections.
regions.soup: The miso broth is golden-brown, clear, and glossy, holding thin noodles and garnishes in a shallow, rounded bowl.
regions.spoon: A white plastic spoon with smooth surface, slightly curved bowl, and rounded tip, resting in ramen broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, thin, and fibrous with slightly curled, translucent strands.
